item.title: Global leaders react after US, Israel strikes on Iran stoke fears of broader conflict
item.description: The initiation of “Operation Epic Fury," which came after weeks of threats from President Trump over the Middle Eastern nation's nuclear program, sparked support from allies but also stoked fear in many countries in the region about the possibility of a wider conflict.
